purpose: replace algebraically non-distinct residual wording with a genuinely base-relative, group-risk-constrained dual-query adapter objective while preserving every no-leakage and exact-fallback invariant

freeze_timing_integrity.trigger: the probability-residual Huber term was proven algebraically equivalent to direct final-probability error, and existing S2/S4 evidence showed pooled gains can harm the old-drug query direction

not_novel_by_itself: CVaR or group distributionally robust optimization
claim_boundary.candidate_joint_mechanism: a label-independent evidence-qualified structural adapter over a frozen cross-fitted DTI base, optimized for base-relative regret on both drug and target query groups with upper-tail no-harm constraints, and exactly identical to the base outside the eligible evidence set

prior_art_boundaries.boundary: generic negative-transfer control is prior art; EQIR does not claim safe transfer broadly

prior_art_boundaries.example: Fair Classifiers that Abstain without Harm
prior_art_boundaries.boundary: group no-harm objectives are prior art; evidence-qualified dual DTI query regret is the task-specific candidate difference

prior_art_boundaries.concept: low regret relative to a user baseline
prior_art_boundaries.example: Calibrated Regression Against An Adversary Without Regret
prior_art_boundaries.boundary: baseline regret is not claimed as new and the cited method concerns online calibrated regression
per-drug ranking is prior art; the amendment requires simultaneous target-query and drug-query base-relative structural regret

unchanged_prediction_function.qualification: a(t) in {0,1}, deterministic and independent of interaction labels
unchanged_prediction_function.exact_fallback: a(t)=0 implies s_theta(d,t) is bitwise identical to b(d,t) before sigmoid

base_relative_dual_query_regret.pair_definition: within one query group, pair each observed positive with a deterministically sampled observed negative from the same frozen TRAIN or inner-VALID boundary
base_relative_dual_query_regret.interpretation: negative regret means the qualified structure adapter improved pairwise ordering relative to the frozen base; positive regret means harm
base_relative_dual_query_regret.why_not_algebraically_equivalent_to_dire: the base loss enters a nonlinear upper-tail group-risk constraint after per-query aggregation; it is not merely an additive constant in the optimized criterion

upper_tail_no_harm_constraints.interpretation: control mean regret in the worst 20 percent of evaluable query groups
upper_tail_no_harm_constraints.optimization: primal-dual AdamW; nonnegative dual variables projected to [0,10] after every update
upper_tail_no_harm_constraints.infeasibility_policy: if no candidate satisfies both inner-validation constraints, return the frozen base for that held fold and record the full candidate as infeasible; do not relax tolerances after seeing results

effective_training_objective.calibration_term: binary cross entropy of p_theta on qualified pairs
effective_training_objective.ordinary_target_pairwise_term: mean ell(mtheta_T), retained as a nonnovel ranking component
effective_training_objective.ordinary_drug_pairwise_term: mean ell(mtheta_D), retained as a nonnovel ranking component
effective_training_objective.constrained_problem: minimize L_BCE + lambda_T*mean(ell(mtheta_T)) + lambda_D*mean(ell(mtheta_D)) + 1e-4*L2 subject to both CVaR regret constraints
effective_training_objective.point_probability_huber: retained only as a preregistered diagnostic variant; it is not the effective full-model objective and cannot support novelty
effective_training_objective.query_sampling: equal numbers of target-query and drug-query positive-negative pairs per step, with deterministic seed-specific sampling and no held-test access

mandatory_nearest_controls: every raw and sigmoid TCP-inspired variant from the nearest-method freezes

selection_and_promotion.inner_selection_objective: equal-weight mean of micro AUPRC, target-macro AUPRC and drug-macro AUPRC after both CVaR constraints are satisfied
selection_and_promotion.required_seed_consistency: at least 4 of 5 seeds improve held-test micro AUPRC versus every mandatory nearest control
selection_and_promotion.required_cold_axis_uncertainty: target-homology-cluster and drug-scaffold bootstrap 95 percent lower bounds for micro AUPRC difference both exceed zero
required_directional_uncertainty: target-macro point difference is nonnegative and grouped CI lower bound is at least -0.002
drug-macro grouped CI lower bound exceeds zero
full model drug-macro exceeds the within-drug permutation 95 percent upper bound
held-test upper-tail query regret is reported separately for target and drug query groups and neither may be positive beyond its frozen 0.01 tolerance
selection_and_promotion.all_development_gates_pass: freeze implementation hash before opening S3 folds 3-4

unchanged_invariants: all 24 later pocket-quality exclusions remain excluded
only the 46 targets excluded solely for missing experimental pocket were recovered into the 384 active scope

no structure fusion model or comparator is trained unless every Stage0 gate passes
